model_output.rationale: All three PT lines (97140-GP, 97530-GP, 97110-GP) denied CO-119/N435. KX modifier is absent from every submitted line. Chart note dated 2026-07-08 documents skilled services as medically necessary, satisfying the clinical justification requirement. Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7; remedy is a clerical-error reopening to append KX. Do not bill the patient — CO-119 is provider liability.

root_cause.explanation: KX modifier absent on all three lines; accumulator exceeded the CY2026 $2,480 PT+SLP threshold. Chart note confirms medical necessity on DOS, so KX omission is a clerical error.

next_action.detail: File a clerical-error reopening with Novitas (Part B does not accept frequency 7). Append KX to 97140-GP, 97530-GP, and 97110-GP. Attach the 2026-07-08 treatment note as supporting documentation.

CO-119+N435 with no KX present and record justifying services → correct_and_resubmit via clerical-error reopening; Part B has no frequency 7 pathway.

citations.rule: CO-119+N435, no KX, record justifies → correct_and_resubmit (clerical-error reopening); never bill patient
